title: Restock Alerts Fire One Unit Too Late
description:
`items_needing_restock(items)` in `notifier.py` should return every item whose `quantity` is at or below its own `reorder_threshold` (defined per item in `inventory.py`). Right now an item exactly at its threshold is skipped. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Files**
`inventory.py` — the `Item` data class
`notifier.py` — decides which items need restocking

**Function signature**
`items_needing_restock(items: list[Item]) -> list[Item]`
